{{Quote|The Hutts originally came from a system called Varl, whose star suffered some sort of disaster. And so they were forced to move to another planetary system.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>}}
The '''Varl system''', also known as the '''Ardos system''', was a [[Binary star system/Legends|binary star]] system that contained the [[Star/Legends|stars]] [[Evona/Legends|Evona]] and [[Ardos/Legends|Ardos]], and had numerous [[Planet/Legends|planets]] including [[Varl/Legends|Varl]]. During the [[Hutt Cataclysms]] in [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], Evona was swallowed by a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]]&mdash;[[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] legend claimed that the god was lured into the collision&mdash;and all of the system's planets except Varl were destroyed in collisions with each other, peppering the system and Varl with [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. According to Hutt legend, Ardos was in agony after the loss of his mate and children, and began to self-destruct by ejecting his gaseous shell, which devastated Varl's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Ardos ultimately condensed into a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]], and the Hutts fled the system for [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Evocar]].
